Name: Cat Plants
Author: AvatarKitten
Description:
Yet another cat themed mod from yours truly, this mod adds in 4 new plants all themed around cats. Grow yourself some catnip, cattails, tigerlilies, and dande-lions. These plants can all be combined into a cake that gives a luck, speed, and defense buff, so it's useful for areas like the mines or Skull Cavern. 

[b]THIS MOD REQUIRES [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CONTENT PATCHER[/url]﻿

Spoilers for seasons, growth times, shop locations, and gift prefs below~

[spoiler]

All seeds are sold by Pierre during their seasons and the recipe for the Cat Cake will be sold by Gus for 1000 G.

Catnip grows in spring, summer, and fall. It takes 7 days to grow, and regrows every 4 days.

Dande-lions grow in spring, and takes 4 days to grow.

Tigerlilies can be grown in summer, and take 7 days.

Catnip grows in spring and summer, and takes 8 days to grow. It will grow faster if planted near water, similar to rice and taro roots.

Catnip, dande-lions, and tigerlilies are all considered flowers for gifting, and will affect beehouses. Cattails are classified as a vegetable for gifting and can be turned into pickles or juice. Cat Cakes are classified as a cooking item for gifting.

[/spoiler]
